text: This report outlines recommendations for the 2019 Student Nutrition Program service subsidy allocations. The proposed combined allocations to the Angel Foundation for Learning and the Toronto Foundation for Student Success total $14,930,117 which includes $100,000 held in reserve for appeals/late applications and $270,000 held in reserve for the expansion to eligible independent schools meeting needs-based assessment criteria.
The Board of Health deferred consideration of the item until its meeting on June 10, 2019.
